title: Protocols and Fee Levels for COVID-19 Treatment Administered by Private Practitioners
what_it_is: Protocols and Fee Levels for COVID-19 Treatment Administered by Private Practitioners

sections.label: COVID-19 treatment fees and long COVID
sections.summary: Doctors treat and charge COVID-19 patients like other acute respiratory diseases, and long COVID patients get the same care as those with lingering effects of other respiratory diseases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Hence, like all diseases, doctors will treat COVID-19 patients based on their clinical assessment and severity of illness.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: This means they will also charge treatment fees similar to other acute respiratory diseases, which is currently about $20 to $35 for subsidised patients at the polyclinics.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Patients with lasting symptoms – that is, long COVID-19 – will be cared for and supported in the same way as patients experiencing lingering effects of other respiratory diseases.

sections.label: S+3M framework for inpatient bills
sections.summary: Inpatients are supported by the S+3M framework, which fully covers bills for patients with financial difficulties, including rare ICU stays.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For the minority that require an inpatient admission, they will be supported by our S+3M framework, that is, subsidies, MediShield Life, MediSave and MediFund.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The fact is S+3M is already designed to fully cover the bills for patients with financial difficulties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: To illustrate, for a patient who is admitted to a C class ward for COVID-19, the median co-payment after subsidies and MediShield Life is about $700, which patients can pay for using their MediSave.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: For those who are unable to use MediSave and have difficulty with cash payment, there is MediFund to help.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The same applies to ICU stay, which is very rare for COVID-19 patients now.

sections.label: Subsidy and support framework continues
sections.summary: The existing framework of subsidy and support, S+3M, will continue.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: The issue about the concerns with regards to costs, same thing, we always had a framework of subsidy and support, as I mentioned earlier, S+3M and this will continue.
